title: 组合两个表

cases.setup: CREATE TABLE Person (personId INT, firstName VARCHAR(50), lastName VARCHAR(50));CREATE TABLE Address (addressId INT, personId INT, city VARCHAR(50), state VARCHAR(50));INSERT INTO Person VALUES (1,'Allen','Wang'),(2,'Bob','Alice');INSERT INTO Address VALUES (1,2,'New York','NY');

note: 输出列: firstName, lastName, city, state（无地址则为 NULL）
